title: Import from Radarr
intro: If you already use Radarr, nexcrate fetches your movies from there into the library.
readOnly: nexcrate only reads. Nothing is changed, deleted or searched again in Radarr.
schedule: is for the transition and the test phase: Radarr stays in charge, nexcrate reads it again every 15 minutes and shows your library. nexcrate loads nothing for these movies.
takeoverNote: is the switch: the movies become nexcrate's own, nexcrate stops reading this Radarr and loads and upgrades them itself from then on. You can switch Radarr off afterwards.

sources.name: Name
sources.nameHint: Anything you like, for example Radarr 4K.
sources.urlHint: The address you open Radarr with in the browser, including the port.
sources.apiKeyHint: You find it in Radarr under Settings, General.
sources.keySaved: A key is saved. Leave the field empty to keep it.
sources.versionHint: Every movie from this Radarr becomes this version in nexcrate.
sources.testNeedsKey: Enter the API key, then the connection can be tested.
sources.missingVersionName: Please give the new version a name.
sources.takenOver: Taken over on {{date}}. nexcrate no longer imports the movies of this Radarr.
sources.takenOverInfo: The movies from this Radarr now belong to nexcrate, together with their files. You still need this record to undo the takeover or to fetch indexers and download clients from there. If you remove it, movies, versions and files stay.
sources.removeRecordHint: Removes only this record. Movies, versions and files stay.
sources.removeRecordText: The record {{name}} disappears from nexcrate. Movies, versions and files stay.

remove.title: Remove connection?
remove.text: The connection {{name}} disappears from nexcrate, together with everything that came into the library through it. Nothing changes in Radarr.

series.takeoverNote: is the switch: the series become nexcrate's own, nexcrate stops reading this Sonarr and loads and upgrades them itself from then on. You can switch Sonarr off afterwards.

series.removeRecordHint: Removes only this record. Series, versions and files stay.
series.removeRecordText: The record {{name}} disappears from nexcrate. Series, versions and files stay.

indexers.added: {{name}} is now added as an indexer.

series.empty: There is no indexer in this Sonarr.
series.keyIntro: Sonarr does not give out the API key. Enter it here.
series.apiKeyHint: You find it in your account at the indexer. If Prowlarr added the indexer to Sonarr, it is Prowlarr's API key.
series.addCategoriesHint: nexcrate has this indexer already. Sonarr's categories are added to its series categories.

music.empty: There is no indexer in this Lidarr.

sonarrNaming.title: Sonarr's naming for {{label}}
sonarrNaming.intro: This is how Sonarr names series folders, season folders and episode files. Taken over it counts for version {{label}} from the next filing on. Existing files keep their names.
sonarrNaming.cannotTake: nexcrate cannot take this naming as it is. What does not fit is shown next to the pattern. {{label}} keeps its naming.

notes.sonarr_no_rename: Sonarr does not rename files, they keep the release name. nexcrate takes that as {Original Title}.
notes.slash_in_pattern: Sonarr creates subfolders with /. nexcrate writes a + there.
notes.colon_format: Sonarr replaces colons differently. nexcrate replaces them like Sonarr's Smart setting.
notes.illegal_characters_kept: Sonarr keeps illegal characters. nexcrate replaces them.
notes.style_differs: Sonarr joins several episodes in one file differently. nexcrate keeps the style from Folders and naming.

takeover.openHint: Makes the movies from this Radarr nexcrate's own and ends the connection.
takeover.title: Take over {{name}}

intro.versions: Every version from {{name}} becomes nexcrate's own, together with its files.
intro.noRead: nexcrate no longer reads this Radarr afterwards. Nothing is deleted.
intro.loads: From then on nexcrate downloads and upgrades for these movies too.
intro.check: First nexcrate checks what would happen. The check changes nothing.
intro.companion: Afterwards nexcrate puts a release.nex into every movie folder. Folders without write permission are reported, the takeover still counts.

takeover.warning: Switch Radarr off afterwards or remove the movies there. Otherwise both programs replace each other's files.
takeover.lost: The last job is gone, for example because nexcrate restarted. It changed nothing. Please check again.
takeover.submit: Take over and end the connection

phase.files: nexcrate is looking for the files …
phase.saving: nexcrate is taking over the versions …
phase.companions: nexcrate is writing the companion files …

running.hint: You can close the window, nexcrate keeps working. When you open it again, it shows where things stand.

failed.check: The check failed. Nothing was changed.
failed.takeover: The takeover failed. Nothing was changed.

takeover.dataFresh: Read from Radarr just now, on {{time}}.
takeover.dataStored: Radarr does not answer right now. The check uses the last import from {{time}}.

roots.title: Folders
roots.intro: Radarr and nexcrate often see the same movies under different paths. nexcrate matches them through sample files of the same size.
roots.same_path: Radarr and nexcrate see the same path.
roots.found: nexcrate found {{matched}} of {{samples}} sample files there.
roots.chosen: Chosen by you. {{matched}} of {{samples}} sample files are there.
roots.none: nexcrate found no matching folder. Choose the folder under which nexcrate sees these movies.
roots.noFiles: Radarr has only movies without a file here. A folder is optional.
roots.derived: nexcrate derived the folder from another root folder.
roots.noneNoFiles: Without a folder nexcrate files these movies into the default folder later.
roots.picked: Chosen: {{local}}. Check again, then nexcrate looks for the sample files there.
roots.pickedNoFiles: Chosen: {{local}}. Check again, then nexcrate tests the folder.

counts.title: Movies and files
counts.otherSize_one: One of them has a different size than in Radarr. nexcrate takes the size on disk.
counts.otherSize_other: {{value}} of them have a different size than in Radarr. nexcrate takes the size on disk.
counts.missingTitle: nexcrate does not find these files

queue.title: Downloads in Radarr
queue.none: Radarr is not downloading anything for these movies right now.

queue.active_other: Radarr is downloading {{value}} movies of this connection right now. Best wait until Radarr has filed them away, then check again.

version.title: Version {{label}}
version.ready: The version has a profile and a default folder. nexcrate can download for it.
version.noProfile: This version has no profile yet. nexcrate only downloads for it once it has one.
version.noFolder: This version has no default folder yet. Without one nexcrate downloads nothing for it. Choose one under Folders and naming.
version.useProposalHint: Most movies from this Radarr are there. nexcrate then files new movies there. Existing movies stay in their folder.

naming.title: Naming
naming.unavailable: Radarr did not answer, so its naming is missing. You can take it later under Folders and naming.
naming.takeHint: nexcrate then names new files of this version like Radarr. Existing files keep their names.
naming.cannotTake: nexcrate cannot take this naming as it is. {{label}} keeps its naming.

notes.title: What changes compared to Radarr
notes.radarr_recycle_bin_one: Radarr kept replaced files for one day. nexcrate keeps them as long as set under Folders and naming.
notes.radarr_recycle_bin_other: Radarr kept replaced files for {{value}} days. nexcrate keeps them as long as set under Folders and naming.
notes.radarrRecycleBinNoDays: Radarr kept replaced files in a recycle bin. nexcrate keeps them as long as set under Folders and naming.
notes.radarr_extra_files: Radarr filed subtitles and other extra files along with the movie. nexcrate files subtitles too when that is switched on under folders and naming, but no other extra files.
notes.radarr_hardlinks_off: Radarr copied torrents instead of linking them. nexcrate links where it can.
notes.radarr_file_date: Radarr set the file date to the release date. nexcrate leaves the date as it is.
notes.radarr_permissions: Radarr changed file permissions after filing. nexcrate writes with the permissions of its container.

confirm.missing: Take over without the missing files

undo.title: Undo takeover
undo.reads: nexcrate then reads {{name}} again every 15 minutes. Its versions come from Radarr again.

undo.keyDeleted: nexcrate deleted the key during the takeover. Enter it once more.
undo.companion: nexcrate takes away the release.nex it wrote for these movies. Files changed by hand stay.

counts.unmapped_other: Lidarr could not map {{value}} files to a track. If they lie in an album folder, nexcrate reads them afterwards.

counts.otherSize_other: {{value}} files have another size than in Lidarr. nexcrate takes the size on disk.

keep.label: Do not upgrade what is there
keep.hint: What the connection brings stays as it is: titles with a file are left alone, episodes with a file are switched off. nexcrate still searches what is missing, and what arrives later is upgraded as usual.

quality.title: Take the quality and the profiles over
quality.intro: The quality profiles, the custom formats and the sizes per quality from {{name}}. Only read; nexcrate never writes into the other app.
quality.line: {{qualities}} qualities, good enough from {{cutoff}}, {{formats}} formats with a score
quality.unknownQualities: nexcrate does not know these qualities and leaves them out: {{qualities}}.
quality.lostConditions: These formats have conditions nexcrate has no type for; they come without them: {{formats}}.
quality.open: Fetch the quality and the profiles
quality.openLabel: Fetch the quality and the profiles: {{name}}

repack.whyThere: At least one profile scores neither a repack nor a proper. The other app takes such fixes as an upgrade by itself; nexcrate has no step of its own for them and takes them only through a format with a score.
repack.whyOff: At least one profile scores neither a repack nor a proper. The other app is set not to prefer such fixes, so nothing changes if you leave it like that.
repack.add: Give these profiles the repack formats of the TRaSH Guides ({{formats}})

release.title: Release profiles
release.intro: There are no release profiles here. "Must not contain" and "must contain" become custom formats, and every profile that comes over scores them minus 10000.
release.boundLine: Bound to an indexer or to tags there, which cannot be rebuilt here. The formats come without a score; give them one by hand where they fit: {{formats}}
release.empty: Holds no term that can be read, left out.
release.unreadable: These terms are no pattern that can be read and are left out: {{terms}}

differs.title: What works differently here
differs.notAllowed: When a file is already there in a quality the profile does not allow, nexcrate leaves it alone, even if it is better than allowed. {{app}} would replace it.
differs.delay: Delay profiles (waiting time, Usenet before torrent) live at the version here, under "Protocol and waiting time". The profile without a tag is read; profiles bound to tags do not come over.
differs.tags: There are no tags. What a tag binds there, the version binds here: it picks its profile.

quality.whereTo: Profiles that came over stand under Settings → Quality → Profiles. A version picks its profile on its own tile.
